verdict.label: Steady market
verdict.headline: Card prices are steady: no strong move either way right now.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 116.2 (+3.9% in a day) and momentum is 50: prices are steady. 84s cost 650, 85s 2,600 and 86s 5,000. Midweek is usually the quietest time to buy cards for the weekend.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-10-28T19:18:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Pelé 95 Base Icon after its 34% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 10,000,000 coins. Now 8,500,000. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 34.0% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 1 of 4 so far, averaging -2.8% after tax. It was paused after losing calls, so this is a low-confidence retest. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Quiet midweek: plan your weekend squad now
moves.detail: Midweek is usually the cheapest time to buy cards you will play at the weekend. The next Rivals rewards come {{t:2026-10-29T07:59:00+00:00}} and add fodder supply.

moves.title: Fodder: 88s are the best value per point, 87s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 650 (0.78 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,600 (1.24 coins per Item Score point), 86s 5,000 (1.22 coins per Item Score point), 87s 7,500 (1.36 coins per Item Score point), 88s 900 (0.11 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 88s then 84s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Gonzalo and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Gonzalo 75 Rare -40.3%; Tarik Muharemović 75 Rare -13.0%; Luis Hernández 86 Base Hero -10.8%; Pau Cubarsí 86 Rare -9.1%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
